name: Measles & vaccine-preventable
summary: US measles cases reach 5,182 in 2026; three deaths reported in a week in New York, Pennsylvania and Wisconsin
state: The CDC counted 5,182 US measles cases in 2026 as of 5 Nov, up 330 in a week (Contagion Live). In the week before that update, New York, Pennsylvania and Wisconsin each reported a measles death; states have reported eight deaths in 2026, against four on the CDC's count. A review of US elimination status was rescheduled to November (KRDO, 2 Mar). Large outbreaks in a high-income country meet Watch; a multi-country surge with rising deaths in high-income countries is not established.
for_you: Measles spreads easily among unvaccinated people. The NHS advises checking that children and adults have had two MMR doses, and travellers to the US or other affected countries should check NHS fit-for-travel guidance.
rubric_hit: Large outbreaks in a high-income country (US 5,182 cases); no multi-country surge in high-income countries

sources.title: KRDO — Meeting to determine US measles elimination status pushed back to November

why: Falling vaccination rates are bringing back diseases once eliminated; measles is the canary for the rest.

rubric.alert: Multi-country surge with rising deaths, or polio/diphtheria resurgence in high-income countries.
rubric.watch: Large outbreaks in high-income countries, or loss of elimination status.
rubric.normal: No large outbreaks in high-income countries.
